problem_or_opportunity: The original HYPE-only breakout lineage was the strongest live seed, but later larger HYPE runs weakened and unsupported cross-asset transfer lost. A full-occupancy replay now shows that short entry authority is materially weaker than long entry authority.
why_now: The prior bidirectional v54 approval request was created before the causal long-only versus short-only occupancy comparison. That new evidence materially changes the safest faithful reconstruction and requires the bidirectional request to be paused.

evidence_reviewed.finding: The first seven HYPE-only closes were 6W/1L, +$2.160920, PF 10.6505, and +$1.261432 excluding the largest winner. Long contributed 5W/1L and +$1.928432; short contributed one winner and +$0.232488.
The larger HYPE-only generation was 0W/2L and -$0.891714. Later cross-asset generations were 12W/17L and -$2.735203; BTC, ETH, and SOL were all negative after removing their largest winner.

On the same native signals and fixed-eight-hour exit contract, full-occupancy development was bidirectional -7,577.71 bps, long-only -2,387.89 bps, and short-only -6,389.48 bps. The already-opened descriptive block was bidirectional -1,166.60 bps, long-only +382.86 bps, and short-only -778.29 bps.
The first report-only forward long path lost $12.093905 after modeled depth, fees, slippage, and exact funding.
The second report-only forward long path gained $13.754459 after modeled depth, fees, slippage, and exact funding. Forward N=2 totals +$1.660554 but becomes -$12.093905 without its largest winner.

applicable_regime.trigger: current completed 5m state enters BREAKOUT after a non-BREAKOUT completed 5m state
applicable_regime.breakout_definition: close beyond the prior 60 completed 5m extrema by at least 8 bps with volume at least 2.5 times the prior 20-bar mean
applicable_regime.exit_authority: short native onset closes an open long; protective stop and fixed eight-hour fallback remain active

alternatives_considered.tradeoff: higher cadence but restores the materially weaker short arm
would suppress the strategy-native opposite-onset profit exit
repeats the unsupported transfer associated with the observed deterioration
preserves a comparator but has not produced current executable evidence

expected_upside: Preserves the strongest observed HYPE-native lineage while removing the weak short entry arm and retaining the native short-onset close. It also prevents the previous cross-asset transfer by construction.
risks_and_failure_modes: Development long-only results remain negative after costs and after removing the largest winner.
The positive descriptive long-only block was already opened and cannot serve as untouched promotion evidence.
Both report-only forward paths are long and the N=2 total depends on one winner.
Suppressing short entries lowers cadence and may miss profitable bear-regime opportunities.
An 80 bps stop is not a guaranteed realized-loss ceiling under gaps, latency, venue failure, or thin liquidity.
A recipe-exit implementation defect could suppress or misapply the opposite-onset close; this must remain lifecycle-bound and restart-safe.

validation_required: Run broader config, poller, router, execution-plan, provider-exit, restart, manual-entry, and TUI regressions.
Run a continuous report-only v3 observer and capture the next attributable long and short native onsets.
Freeze a new candidate source manifest and flat/order-free preflight only after the challenger remains selected.
Obtain separate explicit human approval before any live authority change.
success_metrics: Zero HYPE short entry actions and zero non-HYPE native intents.
Every short native onset remains visible and closes an applicable open long exactly once.
Every live entry, if later approved, has a reconciled reduce-only stop and persisted v3 execution plan.
Report after-cost PnL, fees, funding, MFE, MAE, exit reason, missed opportunities, side, regime, and largest-winner-removed PnL.

failure_and_rollback.technical_failure: Fail closed and preserve or reconcile the reduce-only venue stop. Do not restart until lifecycle identity and exit authority reconcile.
failure_and_rollback.economic_failure: Report losses immediately and return the route to report-only only after a separately approved flat/order-free transition.
failure_and_rollback.rollback_boundary: Transition only while venue-flat and order-free to an independently verified prior bundle.

falsifiers: Any v3 StrategyIntent carries side short or a symbol other than HYPE.
A short native onset cannot close an open v3 long through its persisted plan.
A predeclared compatible prospective long sample is negative after costs and not explained by a correctable defect.
A separately qualified short mechanism demonstrates positive, winner-robust evidence across causal partitions.
Any source, config, venue, ledger, or flat/order-free invariant changes before a future approval boundary.

explicit_approval.scope: No live strategy, route, sizing, leverage, risk, or configuration authority is granted by this report.
